thread:
Anika (Marketing): Quick pulse — finalizing the post-event flows for tomorrow's live lab. Need 3 quick confirmations: 1) registration confirmation email copy + CTAs, 2) Zoom recording retention + transcript flow, 3) who owns clip creation + HubSpot tag routing. Keeping this tight so we can handoff to integrator.

Liam (Events): For reg email: short + two CTAs (watch live / add to calendar). Suggest: 'You're registered — here's how to join, slides + replay will be emailed.' Keep replay CTA disabled until we upload.

Ethan (Growth): Agreed. Also add a micro-survey link in the replay email (1 Q: Which feature was most useful?). We can gate clip access based on survey completion if legal OK.

Priya (Ops): Zoom recording settings set: cloud recording ON, auto-transcribe ON, store for 90 days. Waiting room OFF for smoother join, recording passcode OFF. Zoom-bot: confirm scheduling and cloud hook?

zoom-bot: Meeting scheduled: https://zoom.us/j/999999999?pwd=XXX (host: liam). Cloud recording enabled, live transcript enabled. Webhook to upload/notify S3 on recording.complete configured to /hooks/zoom-upload.

Jonah (Content): Clip ownership: I'll take highlights + 2 x 60s clips. Ethan, can you own growth clips (social cuts + captions)? Anika, who handles transcript + SRT split for editors?

Anika (Marketing): Jonah owns highlight editing, Ethan owns distribution. Priya — can ops push final SRT + raw mp4 to the marketing S3 folder and then ping #marketing with signed link? We need filenames following: YYYYMMDD-eventname_master.mp4 and YYYYMMDD-eventname_transcript.srt

Priya (Ops): Yep. Upload path: s3://redwood-marketing/live-lab/2026-06-11/. Will run a post-process job that emits both MP4 and SRT and then call the HubSpot endpoint. Example webhook payload (matches infra):

```
POST /hooks/hubspot/recording
{
  "event": "recording.complete",
  "s3_mp4": "s3://redwood-marketing/live-lab/2026-06-11/event_master.mp4",
  "s3_srt": "s3://redwood-marketing/live-lab/2026-06-11/event_transcript.srt",
  "tags": ["live-lab", "2026-06-11", "benchmark"]
}
```

Ethan (Growth): For HubSpot routing — tag = live-lab, property 'attended' true/false, source=webinar. Then automated workflow: attended -> nurture sequence A, registered-not-attended -> replay drip.

Jonah (Content): Ownership recap: Jonah = edit highlights + create 2x60s social clips; Ethan = distribution + captions; Anika = replay email copy + survey; Priya = upload + webhook. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:

Liam (Events): Also checklist for greenroom: recording local backup (Liam), confirm slides export (PDF), confirm panelist names in caption feed. I'll be on 30m early to sanity-check audio.

Anika (Marketing): Final copy for confirmation (short): 'You're in! Add this to your calendar → [Add to calendar link]. Join live: <zoom link>. Replay, slides & clips will be emailed within 48 hours.' Use that in the reg page and the initial confirmation.

Priya (Ops): Noted. I'll set retention to 90 days then TTL to 14 days for public replay link unless legal asks for change. Webhook will include a field "replay_url_ttl_days": "14".

Ethan (Growth): One more: set tagging for trial-keyword if attendee is from trial company domain — we want an SLA follow up from AE. Priya can you add domain parsing to the webhook?

Priya (Ops): Yup will add "company_domain" and "is_trial" boolean.

Anika (Marketing): Perfect. We'll ship the confirmation email template now and loop in legal for the TTL. Thanks everyone — last call if anything to change.

Liam (Events): All good from events. See you in greenroom. :raised_hands:
